Ava: Quick async check — Q3 OKR interlock for runtime v2 + model routing. TL;DR: some work shipped, some slipped. Please post one-line ownership status + blockers by end of day.

Raj: Shipped — continuous batching integration merged to main and rolled to canary, PR #3421. No perf regressions seen so far.

Mei: Slipped — kernel selection heuristics still failing on long-context tests, repro-ing locally. Suspect memory fragmentation on eviction path.

Sam: Owner for model routing task. Blocker: infra quota to spin up extra GPU pool for scale testing. Filed infra request earlier.

Jordan: I can help with quota if we have the qps/concurrency numbers. Pinged infra ticket INF-789 for updates.

Ava: Action items: Raj post perf numbers for canary, Mei share failing test logs + minimal repro, Sam confirm exact quota delta. Also we need a roll-forward vs rollback decision tree.

Raj: Perf snapshot (canary): p50=42ms, p95=180ms for 512 tokens on A100; throughput stable at 120 req/s with batching. Uploading detailed runbook and csv: https://redwood.link/perf-canary-1789

Mei: Log excerpt: ```OOM at kv_cache_alloc 0x7f... seq=2048
stack: allocator::alloc -> kv_cache::reserve -> attention_kernel```
Repro: run tests/long_ctx_eviction --batch 8 --seq 2048. Will try memory-stride patch and post results.

Sam: Quota request: +4 GPUs for 2wks to cover canary + staging. Infra replied with partial approval. @Jordan can you escalate for the remaining capacity?

Jordan: INF-789 updated: approved +2 GPUs for canary and +1 for staging immediately. One more GPU requires cost sign-off from finance. Tagging billing cadence.

Ava: OK. Next steps recap: Mei try memory-stride patch and post CI; Raj run perf with staging scale and compare to canary; Sam coordinate infra bump and confirm exact instance types; Jordan handle cost notification. Check-in by EOW please.

deploy-bot: deployment runtime-v2-canary succeeded at 1789123600 :tada:

Mei: Quick ask — need the failing prompt/test vector for regression monitoring. @Ava can you drop the minimal prompt set somewhere?

Ava: Will dump a 6-prompt set in #eng-ml and link it here by EOD.

Sam: CR pings — please review `runtime/allocator.cpp` PR #3468, touches stride allocation and eviction heuristics. Low risk but needs 2 approvals.

Raj: Reviewing now, leaving comments. ETA EOD.

Jordan: Noted cost implication for the extra GPU. I'll add a short note to the billing thread and loop finance.

Ava: Thanks all. If anyone hits a hard blocker (infra or perf regression) call it out with `@oncall` and we will triage live. Otherwise we'll reconvene Tuesday AM for a short sync. :thumbsup:
